## What's new
- Open embedded document images in a native window and save their original bytes from the image context menu. - The sidebar follows the active document, expands its folders and highlights its row. A new preference enables or disables this behavior and is on by default.
Active-file following can be changed in Preferences → General → On this Mac. Search and visibility filters remain respected, and background refreshes preserve manual navigation.
This beta package is for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or newer.

Extension preferences are more compact: each card shows its state through the switch without a duplicate Enabled/Disabled caption. This applies to global and project settings; accessible switch state remains available.
This beta is for Apple silicon Macs. Please report any problems before stable promotion.

LeonardoMD 0.1.671 (beta)
- Open MDLZ documents refresh after external changes. Unsaved edits remain protected with a choice to reload the disk version or save a copy. - Optional offline charts, citations, footnotes and callouts are available through global and project preferences. New options are disabled by default. - PDF export retains the fix for switching between Preview and Split, including local images and Mermaid diagrams.
Charts support bounded inline data and static SVG. Citations use local BibTeX or CSL-JSON with APA formatting; online lookup is unavailable. Existing math-rendering limitations remain unchanged.
This beta also includes internal validation improvements for development evidence. Install the signed and notarized macOS Apple Silicon package, or select Beta in Preferences → Updates. Publishing this beta does not change your selected update subscription. Hosted update, installation and relaunch acceptance for this candidate is pending.

## Updates
- Additional app instances now receive normal Quit requests before an update downloads. Unsaved documents and active Git operations retain their usual close checks. - An update stops if an instance refuses to close or remains open. New instances are blocked while the installer is pending. - The update flow dismisses its Preferences sheet while preserving unrelated dialogs and pending decisions. - Automatic update checks remain available; downloads require your approval.
## Known limitations
- Updating from an older version still uses that version's close behavior. If it remains open, finish any save or Git operation, close Preferences, and quit normally. - Instances that have already closed remain closed if another instance cancels. - Install and relaunch testing of this beta is pending.
